d1.review.title: Changes
d1.review.countPartial: Core produced no diff for at least one entry, so these totals cover only the files it published rows for.
d1.review.kindUnknown: Core named no change kind for this path.
d1.review.close: Close review and return to the transcript
d1.review.selectFile: Select a file to see its rows.
d1.review.splitUnavailable: Split view is not built; the unified body is the only one this build renders.
d1.review.pending: Reading the workspace diff from Core…
d1.review.rejected: Core refused this diff read and gave no reason.
d1.review.empty: No changes in the working tree.
d1.review.unavailable: Core published no {capability}, so structured diff rows are unavailable. This is not a clean working tree.
d1.review.truncated: This page is partial: the byte bound dropped at least one file's rows. Their counts are still real.
d1.review.stale: Core published a workspace change after this page was read; re-reading.
d1.review.omitted: Rows not shown ({additions} additions, {deletions} deletions) — over the byte bound.
d1.review.noDiff: Core produced no diff for this file. This does not mean it is unchanged.
d1.review.commitEmpty: A commit needs a message: Core refuses an empty one rather than opening an editor.
d1.review.commitTooLong: Commit message is {bytes} bytes; Core's bound is {limit}.
d1.review.actionUnavailable: Operator source-control actions are unavailable: Core publishes no {capability}.
d1.review.actionNoOwner: No Lane is selected, so this client has no Core owner to act as.
d1.review.actionBusy: A source-control action is already running.
d1.review.actionAwaitingApprovalDetail: {action} is waiting for approval in the permission dock.
d1.review.actionRejected: Core refused the action before anything ran.
d1.review.actionOutputTruncated: Output cut at Core's 8 KiB bound.
d1.review.actionPairStopped: The commit did not complete, so the push was not sent.
d1.review.failed.nothingToCommit: Nothing is staged, so there was nothing to commit.
d1.review.failed.nonFastForward: The remote has work this branch does not. Fetch first, then reconcile — this client does not pull.
d1.review.failed.authenticationRequired: Git could not authenticate to the remote. Configure the credential outside Viden; retrying here cannot supply one.
d1.review.failed.remoteUnreachable: The remote could not be reached.
d1.review.failed.noUpstream: This branch has no upstream, so ahead and behind would be unknowable. Push once with set-upstream to create one.
d1.review.failed.pathOutsideRepository: A path left the target, so it was refused rather than clamped.
d1.review.failed.other: Git reported a failure this build does not classify.
d1.review.failed.unknown: Core reported a failure class this build does not know.

d12.conflict.title: Conflict hunks
d12.conflict.notMerge: Two sides plus the patch preimage — not a merge result. Core computes no merge base and resolves nothing here, so there is no merged text and no resolve action.
d12.conflict.truncated: Over Core's byte bound: at least one file's hunks were dropped.
d12.conflict.omitted: Hunks not shown — this file's lines were over Core's byte bound.
d12.conflict.noHunks: Core listed this file with no hunks.
d12.conflict.noFiles: Core published conflict content naming no file.
d12.conflict.ours: OURS · the Lane's current file, from line {line}
d12.conflict.theirs: THEIRS · the incoming patch, from line {line}
d12.conflict.base: BASE · what the patch expected to find
d12.conflict.base.absent: This hunk carried no preimage at all.
d12.conflict.base.empty: The patch expected an empty region here.
d12.conflict.emptySide: Core read no lines on this side.
d12.conflict.reason.context_mismatch.rem: The preimage was not found in the file. The origin Lane has to re-derive its patch against the current content; nothing can be applied from here.
d12.conflict.reason.already_applied.reme: The file already holds this hunk's new side at that range, so there is nothing left to apply.
d12.conflict.reason.file_missing.remedy: The patch changes a file that is not in the target tree. This is a file-level decision, not a hunk-level one.
d12.conflict.reason.file_deleted.remedy: The deletion's preimage does not account for the whole file, so the file would be left behind. This is a file-level decision.
d12.conflict.reason.binary.remedy: Core reported the content as non-text, so there are no lines to match.
d12.conflict.reason.unnamed.remedy: This build does not name Core's reason, so it is shown exactly as Core published it.
d12.conflict.absent.record: Core published no structured conflict content for this bounce. A bounce an operator raised with a reason has no failed apply behind it and carries none by contract.
d12.conflict.absent.capability: Core publishes no structured conflict content ({capability}), so the conflicting hunk cannot be shown.
d1.evidence.title: Evidence
d1.evidence.searchScope: Filters the {rows} entries already loaded. Core publishes no evidence search, so an entry on a page you have not loaded is not searched.
d1.evidence.searchEmpty: No loaded entry matches this search. The archive holds {rows} loaded entries; this is the search box, not Core.
d1.evidence.complete: Archive complete — Core published every entry matching this scope.
d1.evidence.pending: Reading the evidence archive from Core…
d1.evidence.unavailable: Core publishes no evidence archive ({capability}), so there is nothing to page. This is not an empty archive.
d1.evidence.stale: Core recorded evidence after this list was read.
d1.evidence.noCanonical: This entry names no canonical bytes, so Core has none to serve for it.
d1.evidence.noLinks: This entry names no other Core object.
d1.evidence.metadataNote: Core's own keys, shown exactly as it recorded them. Nothing here is interpreted.
d1.evidence.content.absent: Select this entry to read its canonical bytes from Core.
d1.evidence.content.pending: Reading the canonical bytes from Core…
d1.evidence.content.truncated: Over Core's 256 KiB bound: the content is cut. This does not mean the evidence was short.
d1.evidence.content.unknown: Core published a content shape this build cannot name ({kind}), so nothing is rendered for it.
d1.evidence.reason.summaryOnly: Display-only evidence — Core holds no canonical bytes for it.
d1.evidence.reason.missingCanonicalBytes: Core names canonical bytes the store no longer holds.
d1.evidence.reason.hashMismatch: Canonical bytes failed verification — not shown.
d1.evidence.reason.binary: The canonical bytes verify and are not text, so there is no body to show.
d1.evidence.reason.unnamed: Core named a reason this build does not model ({reason}).
d1.evidence.openInReview.scope: Opens DiffReview, which reads the current working tree — not this recorded patch.
d1.evidence.openInReview.notPatch: Only a patch entry opens in review.
d1.evidence.openInReview.unbound: No host is bound, so the review cannot be opened.
d1.evidence.openInReview.unavailable: Core publishes no structured diff, so the review has nothing to read.
d1.evidence.openAudit.scope: Opens the audit trail scoped to this evidence object. Audit rows link evidence, never the reverse.
d1.activity.auditFallback: falls back to raw event replay when Core publishes no runtime.audit
d1.center.close: Close and return to the conversation
d1.center.failed: Core did not answer this view: {reason}
d1.statusbar.config.head: Ambient items · checked ones are shown
d1.statusbar.config.foot: Identity and actionable items are always pinned.
d1.palette.action.newLane.unknown: Core published no workspace eligibility, so nothing here can say whether a Lane can be created.
d4.step.role.lead: The preset is the role model Core has: coder, reviewer, tester. Branch and worktree are resolved by Core from the reviewed request.
d4.step.agent.lead: The agents Core published for this workspace. The starter-Lane command carries no agent binding, so this step records the choice and names what happens next.
d4.step.skills.lead: Skills and context injection, as the design's third step draws them.
d4.step.gates.lead: Gate policy is code: Core resolves it from the repository and this step is a read-only preview of what it resolved.
d4.seed.note: The task is not part of the create command: Core's StarterLaneRequest carries the Lane id, preset, branch and worktree only. It travels as the first message once the Lane is open, exactly as the compact New Lane creator sends it.
d4.agent.none: No host is bound, so Core published no agent adapters to list here.
d4.agent.note: Creating a starter Lane does not start an Agent session: Core's StarterLaneRequest carries no agent. The chosen agent is started from the cockpit once the Lane exists.
d4.skills.unavailable: Core publishes no skill pack, skill list, or context-injection fact on frontend-contract-v1, and the starter-Lane request carries no field for one, so nothing can be selected here.
d4.target.localOnly: Execution target is local: Core resolves every starter Lane to the machine it runs on, and the request carries no target. Remote targets are designed in D9 and are not on this contract.
d1.picker.configureHint: Project intake: probe, viden.toml, credentials, starter Lanes
d1.activity.queueUnknown: Core published no decision count, so this carries no badge; an empty badge is not an empty queue.
